context_requirements: Expression of KDM6A/KDM6B (UTX/JMJD3) or other JmjC demethylases
Intact p53 pathway for robust CDKN1A induction
Active NF-kB/PI3K-AKT signaling for inflammatory/anti-apoptotic gene effects
falsifiers: No change in H3K27me3-repressed target genes at 6 or 24 h
No antiproliferative or cell-cycle transcriptional signature at 24 h
No induction of CDKN1A or GADD45A/B
No reduction in MYC or E2F target genes
Responses identical to vehicle across all nine lines

evidence.supports: GSK-J4 inhibits JMJD3/UTX, increases H3K27me3, and affects apoptosis, cell cycle, DNA damage repair, metabolism, and oxidative stress pathways
JMJD3 inhibition by GSK-J1 recruits repressive H3K27me3 and alleviates inflammatory signaling
GSK-J4 decreases proliferation and induces apoptosis in chondrosarcoma cells
GSK-J4 inhibits proliferation, arrests G2/M, induces apoptosis, and suppresses PI3K/AKT/NF-kB signaling

changes: Removed FOS, JUN, and EGR1 from proximal_up and late_up: these immediate-early genes are not established direct demethylase-inhibitor targets and their direction is not justified by the cited abstracts.
Removed FOS, JUN, and EGR1 from proximal_up and late_up to avoid listing genes whose direction cannot be justified by the mechanism.

Kept CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B, TSC22D3, NFKBIA, IER3, DUSP4, DUSP6, ATF5, CEBPD, and HMOX1 as up because they are consistent with stress, cell-cycle arrest, and anti-inflammatory responses reported for GSK-J4/GSK-J1.

Kept MYC, CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, E2F2, MYBL2, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, BIRC5, CDC20, UBE2C, and KIF20A as down because they are proliferation/cell-cycle genes consistent with the antiproliferative effects of histone demethylase inhibitors.
No gene appears in both an up and a down list at the same time.
No generic proliferation or stress genes were added to proximal lists beyond those already justified by the cited abstracts.
Line responses left unchanged because the cited abstracts do not provide line-specific data for the nine listed cell lines.
Kinetics and magnitude left unchanged because the cited abstracts do not provide sufficient time-course or quantitative data to contradict the stated slow kinetics and weak-to-moderate magnitude.
Evidence list left unchanged because each cited abstract supports the stated claim.
